title: sedum album var. gypsicola
intro: Sedum album var. gypsicola, commonly known as White Sedum or Gypsum Sedum, is a succulent plant species that belongs to the Crassulaceae family. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in wound healing, skin conditions, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Sedum album var. gypsicola include reducing inflammation, fighting against cancer cells, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
